text: Auto Eder GmbH (Kolbermoor, Bavaria) describes itself as a family-led company (familiengeführtes Traditionsunternehmen); its managing partners (geschäftsführende Gesellschafter) are Peter Eder and Josef Eder.
short: Auto Eder is family-led; its managing partners are Peter Eder and Josef Eder.

source.name: Auto Eder Gruppe: Philosophie und Werte
source.quote: Peter Eder & Josef Eder - Geschäftsführende Gesellschafter
